findings.value: A pub on Columbia Road, E2, with a ground-floor bar and a new upstairs room for private parties. Its launch listing says the doors opened for the first time in May 2026.

notes: The operator's listings are the only current source. Londonist's pub review is dated 2015 and describes an earlier owner (Draft House), so it is not used for crowd or music. The operator's cocktail-bar copy on the same page is about a different site (Fitzrovia) and was not used. The launch listing (15 May 2026) is the only source for the relaunch; no press review found.
